options.rationale: Correct: paid search buys placement quickly.

options.text: SEO guarantees the top paid ad slot
options.rationale: SEO affects organic, not paid, placement.

options.text: Paid search permanently improves organic rankings
options.rationale: Paid clicks do not raise organic rank.
